verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Though war may rise against me I'll not fear
Though armies may all surround me this is clear
Though war may rise against me I'll not fear
Though armies may all surround me this is clear

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Lord, You know that one thing I have desired
There's one thing I'll surely seek
I want to dwell in
Your house for all my days

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
Lead me to the Rock that is higher than I
For You have been my refuge for all of my life
So let me dwell in Your house forever
And find my refuge in the shelter of Your wings

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Oh God You are my life and my strength
You are the only One who can save
I find my rest and peace in Your shade
You're my defense, I won't be afraid

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Hear my cry, O Lord, and listen to my prayer
You have been my strength against my enemies
For You have heard my vows
And given me a portion with the ones who fear Your name

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
My soul waits
For You alone
In You is
My salvation

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
And from the ends of the earth I call out to You
And when my heart is failing I'll call out to You
